items: New nan clip that mouths the real words, 'Poor bastard' (the old one mouthed 'Poor bloke', one syllable under two). Her line laid in one unbroken piece: 'Poor' on her first opening, the b of 'bastard' on her lip closure.
Shot ends before she mouths an extra word, so the cut is now 25.4 s.
Does the lip sync hold now?
Happy with it? Say 'it's done' and it goes into Premiere.

replies.at26: Done: real headline, newsprint style, 0.5–3.2 s, below his face; everything else unchanged. Source: ITV News, 22 Mar 2024 (the article's own title; the headline doesn't name him).
replies.at429: Done: effects lowered 8 dB everywhere (-30 → -38 LUFS), about 20 dB under both voices now.

replies.at627: Fixed with a new clip: Flow allowed 'Poor bastard' after all with a bare prompt (the first refusal was the long prompt). Her lips close for the P and the b, and the voice now lands on both; checked frame by frame.
